verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents general autonomous coding-agent capabilities—natural language task execution, PR creation, workflow fixes, security remediation—that imply it can implement features and open PRs end-to-end, but no evidence explicitly confirms it writes or runs tests as part of feature implementation. missing for 10: explicit documentation/demo of test generation, evidence of full feature-to-merge workflow with test verification, and independent confirmation of end-to-end correctness.
